# ComposureCDK

> Composable, lifecycle-managed AWS infrastructure for the AWS CDK: builders with secure defaults, composed into systems with `compose()`, wired with `ref`. Newer than most model training data, so read the agent rules before writing code with it.

## Start here

- [Agent rules](https://github.com/laazyj/composureCDK/blob/main/packages/core/docs/agent-rules.md): the rules for laying out an app or builder library, condensed for coding agents. Also shipped in the `@composurecdk/core` package, at `docs/agent-rules.md`.
- [Review rubric](https://github.com/laazyj/composureCDK/blob/main/packages/core/docs/review-rubric.md): how to review a change against the rules, with checks, severities and a report format. Also shipped in the `@composurecdk/core` package, at `docs/review-rubric.md`.
- [Audit guide](https://github.com/laazyj/composureCDK/blob/main/packages/core/docs/audit.md): how to audit an existing app against the rules before upgrading or refactoring it. Also shipped in the `@composurecdk/core` package, at `docs/audit.md`.

## Reference

- [Architecting an app](https://github.com/laazyj/composureCDK/blob/main/docs/guide/architecting-an-app.md): a worked example of the rules, from one `compose()` to subsystems across several stacks.
- [Catalogue of principles](https://github.com/laazyj/composureCDK/blob/main/docs/guide/principles.md): look up a rule's reasons and sources by its ID.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/laazyj/composureCDK/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): lifecycle, builders, `compose`, `ref`, defaults and policies.
- [Stack management](https://github.com/laazyj/composureCDK/blob/main/docs/stack-management.md): placing components in stacks, and cross-stack references.
- [Packages](https://github.com/laazyj/composureCDK/tree/main/packages): one README per AWS service.
- [Examples](https://github.com/laazyj/composureCDK/blob/main/packages/examples/README.md): deployable apps.
